name: Eset Rose
reason: Too thin for a full page: beyond her one Kripalu programme (Radiance, 18 to 20 Dec 2026) there is only a private nine-month creative mentorship; no books, no teaching videos of her own (YouTube has only a short panel submission and old Alicia Keys tour clips), no free resources, and retreats are waitlist-only with none listed. Her site presents the work mainly as creative mentorship, consulting and speaking rather than spiritual teaching.
